source.title: Survival and maturation of human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived dopaminergic progenitors in the parkinsonian rat brain is enhanced by transplantation in a neurotrophin-enriched hydrogel

material: Cells alone (no hydrogel, no neurotrophins) control

biology.species: human cells in athymic nude rat

other_outcomes.evidence: 2.1 ± 1.6% of surviving cells differentiated into dopaminergic neurons when the cells were transplanted alone
other_outcomes.name: percentage of surviving cells differentiated into TH+ dopaminergic neurons

other_outcomes.evidence: only 1/6 rats in the ‘Cells alone’ group had dopaminergic maturation of >5%
other_outcomes.name: rats with dopaminergic maturation >5%

notes: Control group: 300 000 iPSC-DAPs transplanted without biomaterial into 6-OHDA lesioned striatum.
